Institute

A weekly gathering for young people: a lesson, games and food. Faith, friendship and lots of fun.

A gathering for young people

Institute is a weekly gathering designed especially for young people. We begin with a short lesson about Jesus Christ — His teachings, His life and how to apply His principles today — and then we share games, food and plenty of time together.

It doesn't matter whether you are a member of the Church or have never heard of it. Institute is for everyone. It is an open, warm, no-pressure space where the most important thing is to have a good time and make friends.

What happens at Institute?

  • A short, interactive lesson on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ
  • Time for questions and conversation — everyone can take part
  • Group games: board games, sports, creative activities...
  • Shared food — sometimes everyone brings something, other times everything is prepared
  • A multicultural environment where many languages are spoken

Who is it for?

Institute is designed for young people roughly between 18 and 35, though there are always exceptions. If you want to meet new people, learn something interesting about Christ and have a good time, you are welcome.

Many who come are looking for community — especially if they are new to the city or going through a time of spiritual searching. Here you will find a group that welcomes you without judging.

Come to the next Institute

Write to us and we will tell you when and where the next gathering is. All you have to do is show up.
